strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.coach: Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 23/33 passes (70%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.8 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, that 8.8 was a big ol' slice of good football.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at pijany's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ A goal against pijany. Goals change games, and you changed this one.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ BellyTb1 owes you a milkshake for those passes.

WORK ON
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Keep this in your pocket: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 70% passing (23 of 33). Here's the fix: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Funny how forcing passes snagged you and tuxedo_slide both. Remedy: give each other short options.

Training ground: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Biscuits are on me, again. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 50% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.7 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.7. That ranks as your 2nd best match performance. Proud of you, partner.

DID WELL
+ A hat trick against pijany, your 3rd straight match scoring. You finished it like the last bite of a good steak.
+ 0.7 over your typical rating. The work is paying off.
+ 8.7 goes down as your 2nd best match performance. Somebody write that down.
+ 5 shots on target: +0.2. The fundamentals are your friend.
+ Team won 4-2. Being part of a winning group is a habit worth keeping.

WORK ON
- 50% passing (8 of 16, down from your usual 68%). Habit to build: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 39%). Little adjustment: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Passes attempted: 16. Middle of the pack for a midfielder; the top quarter hits 25+. Room to climb.
- Tackles attempted: 3. 6+ is where the magic lives.
- Key passes: 0. One gear up gets you to 2+.

Practice pointer: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Hey, BellyTb1. Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Stay hydrated and humble. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
tuxedo_slide, your worst match performance: 7.2. Not your night, still your team.

DID WELL
+ BellyTb1 scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Little things, big difference.
+ We beat pijany 4-2. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Simple fix: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. Fix it and forget it.
- 48% passing (10 of 21). Lesson of the day: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Real quick: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard. Rome, day by day.
- forcing passes hit you and PhogsToffees both. Partner drill: give each other short options.
- That's your worst match performance with a 7.2. We go again.

Quick drill: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

tuxedo_slide, here's what I'd tell my own kid: The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

Water the plant; it'll grow. - Coach Lasso
